verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say agents (Claude Code or Codex) run in a checkout on the user's own machine and poll Foreloop for approved tasks. No managed cloud runtime that executes agents for the developer is documented. Foreloop hosts the coordination service (task queue, MCP endpoint, widget), but that is not hosted agent execution, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a managed cloud offering to run agents without operating my own backend infrastructure
